description:
Create a hollow 90-degree pipe elbow fitting in FreeCAD. 

Specifications:
- Pipe Outer Diameter: 25 mm (Radius: 12.5 mm)
- Pipe Inner Diameter: 21 mm (Wall thickness: 2 mm)
- Bend Radius: 40 mm (Centerline radius)
- Bend Angle: 90 degrees

Save the result as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/pipe_elbow.FCStd'. The model must be a single hollow solid.
